menuNativeTiming.summary: Three normal Garage clicks fail their original 15s stable wait after a completed first menu frame. A second automatic frame is submitted shortly after reveal; its last native fence query reports TIMEOUT_EXPIRED, with no later query during the click wait. Timers continue with no active callback while native RAF and screencast do not advance.
menuNativeTiming.inferenceBoundary: The last TIMEOUT_EXPIRED is a last-observed state, not proof of GPU incompletion throughout the unpolled click interval. Supports recovery around the observed repeated automatic-orbit submissions. It does not show a synchronous draw callback still executing during failed clicks, identify a specific GPU/compositor cause, or validate the new recovery candidate. Local5235 cold startup failed earlier and is separate.
